_comment: Same two sections as the other step maps. `_ignore` is text the artboard shows as SAMPLE — a name, an address, a price, a summary line — which the running page renders from what the visitor entered. Everything NOT listed there is structural copy and has to appear. The remaining keys are the BOX map, { appSelector: artboardSelector }; only the pairing is declared, every expected value is read off the artboard.
_plus_note: The artboard's fourth card is "Platba a členství" and lists a Cleansia Plus trial, and its back link reads "Zpět na Cleansia Plus". The Plus step it refers to is not built — its concepts are still with the owner — so this step's fourth card is payment alone and the rail has five steps, not six. Both artboard strings are in _ignore for that reason, not because they are sample data. The Plus step, the membership line on this card, and moving the preferred-cleaner picker onto it are one piece of work waiting on that decision.

.cl-wiz__note-input.why: The artboard draws this as a div holding sample text at placeholder grey, so its `color` is the placeholder's and not a value's — the real control is empty at check time and reports its text colour. `whiteSpace` is `pre-wrap` on every textarea and `normal` on that div. Size, weight, padding, radius and border are all still asserted.
